vulnerabilities.description: Heartbleed: the TLS heartbeat extension leaks server memory.
vulnerabilities.risk: Remote attackers can read private keys, passwords and session data from process memory.

vulnerabilities.description: Shellshock: bash executes commands trailing function definitions in environment variables.
vulnerabilities.risk: Remote code execution wherever untrusted input reaches environment variables (CGI, SSH, DHCP).

vulnerabilities.description: zlib memory corruption when compressing crafted input.
vulnerabilities.risk: Crashes or memory corruption in programs compressing attacker-controlled data.

vulnerabilities.description: zlib memory corruption when compressing crafted input.
vulnerabilities.risk: Crashes or memory corruption in programs compressing attacker-controlled data.

vulnerabilities.description: SOCKS5 proxy handshake heap buffer overflow in curl/libcurl.
vulnerabilities.risk: A malicious server or proxy could corrupt memory and possibly execute code.

vulnerabilities.description: Baron Samedit: heap overflow in sudoedit argument handling.
vulnerabilities.risk: Any local user can escalate to root.

vulnerabilities.description: Proxy-Authorization header can leak to the destination server on HTTPS redirects.
vulnerabilities.risk: Proxy credentials may be exposed to third-party servers.

vulnerabilities.description: Cookie header is not stripped on cross-origin redirects.
vulnerabilities.risk: Session cookies can leak to another origin.

vulnerabilities.description: Arbitrary code execution when loading untrusted YAML with the full loader.
vulnerabilities.risk: Parsing attacker-supplied YAML can run arbitrary code.

vulnerabilities.description: Session cookie may be cached and served to other users by a caching proxy.
vulnerabilities.risk: Session data can be exposed to other clients.

vulnerabilities.description: The xmlattr filter allows attribute injection through keys containing spaces.
vulnerabilities.risk: Cross-site scripting in templates that render untrusted attribute keys.
